parameters.name: SkipAudit
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the current message content requires Alibaba Cloud Content Moderation. Valid values:

- **true**: Content Moderation is not required.
- **false** (default): Content Moderation is required.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Message type. When the type field value is less than or equal to 10000, it indicates a system message. When the value is greater than 10000, it indicates a custom message.
